_comment: Registry of sources used to build/verify the preloaded course catalog. Each entry id is referenced from catalog JSON files (sourceRef / dataNotes). Kind: official | secondary-mirror | archived-notice. Verified rows must reference an entry here.

sources.name: PCTB — Punjab Curriculum & Textbook Board
sources.note: Official publisher of Punjab textbooks (PTB renamed PCTB, 2021). Books free-to-view/download on its portal.

sources.name: class9.pk — 9th class new PTB books
sources.note: Mirrors official PCTB 9th books incl. chapter course outlines (2025/2026 editions).

sources.name: class10.pk — 10th class new PTB books
sources.note: Mirrors official PCTB 10th new books (2026-27) incl. chapter course outlines.

sources.name: ilmkidunya — PTB book & notes pages
sources.note: Chapter-wise lists of official PTB textbooks (new syllabus).

sources.name: freeilm — new syllabus notes 2025-27
sources.note: Unit lists of PTB new-syllabus books (2025-26 / 2026-27).

sources.name: studyplusplus — NBF/FBISE 9 physics (2025)
sources.note: National Book Foundation Class 9 Physics 2025 (NCP 2022-23) chapter list.

sources.name: National Curriculum Council — Approved Model Textbooks on SNC (29 Sep 2021)
sources.note: Official approval list (245 rows): NBF model books grades Pre-1-5 + approved private publishers (Oxford, AFAQ, Gohar, etc.) for Islamabad Capital Territory.

sources.name: University of the Punjab — B.A./B.Sc./Associate Degree course outlines
sources.note: Official PU course-outline page listing compulsory, elective and optional subjects for B.A./B.Sc./Associate Degree Part-II (arts & science).

sources.name: University of the Punjab — admission notice (AD semester system)
sources.note: Official notice: Associate Degree in Science/Arts (B.A./B.Sc.) Annual System Part-I/II is replaced by 2-year/4-semester Associate Degree programs (double-major or subject-specific).

sources.name: Oxford University Press Pakistan — school catalogue
sources.note: OUP Pakistan school series (New Countdown 3rd ed Books 1-8, Urdu Ka Guldasta SNC 1-8, Oxford Progressive English, New Syllabus Mathematics, Science Fact File, etc.).

sources.name: AFAQ (Association for Academic Quality) — products
sources.note: AFAQ SNC-aligned series: Sun Series, Iqbal Series, Nakhla readers, workbooks, class 1-8.

sources.name: Gohar Publishers — SNC resources
sources.note: Gohar SNC series class 1-8: English, Nida-e-Urdu, Mathematics, Science, General Knowledge, Social Studies; Spark SNC Mathematics.

sources.name: National Book Foundation (NBF) — Federal textbooks
sources.note: Publisher of Federal (FBISE/FDE) model textbooks grades 1-12 under SNC/NCP.

sources.name: pastpapersfbise — FBISE model paper subject lists
sources.note: FBISE SSC/HSSC subject sets (English/Urdu compulsory, Biology/Physics/Chemistry/Mathematics/Computer/Pak Studies/Islamiyat) mirroring official scheme.

sources.name: topstudyworld — FG/NBF textbooks class 1-9
sources.note: Inventory of official NBF textbooks for Federal Government schools (55 books, class 1-9).

sources.name: ilmdo.com — PTB new books 2026-27
sources.note: 9th class new PTB book inventory for session 2026-27 incl. Tarjuma-tul-Quran.

sources.name: zahidnotes — 9th biology ALP test papers
sources.note: Corroborates new 9th Biology unit list (units 10-11: Reproduction in Plants, Biostatistics).

sources.name: lasthopestudy — 9th English new book 2025-26
sources.note: Unit list of 9th English new book 2025-26 (secondary mirror).

sources.name: tutorsaad — 10th new books session 2026-27
sources.note: 10th class new PCTB books overview for 2026-27 (secondary).

sources.name: Oxford University Press Pakistan — Teaching Guides 2025-26
sources.note: 2025-26 catalogue: New Countdown (Third Edition) Starter/Primer A-B/Books 1-8 ISBNs; Urdu Ka Guldasta (Khususi Isha'at) 1-8; NSM Books 1-4 (7th ed).
